s1.heading: Your role
s1.body: Tiles, KPIs, and stage gates all change based on your persona. Use this menu (⌘K) to switch instantly.

s2.heading: Approvals are waiting
s2.body: Anything that needs your decision surfaces here first. Hover for context, click to open.
s2.tip: Click the badge to jump straight to the inbox.

s3.heading: Slip → claim
s3.body: Drop a photo of your receipt. We'll OCR the vendor, amount, and date — confirm and submit.

s4.heading: Ask the AI coach
s4.body: Type ⌘K anywhere or use the search below. The coach answers from your actual charts and ledgers.
s4.cockpitAi: Ask about cash, runway, or categories
s4.tip: Tip: AI answers are based on your real data.

role.staff: You're a Staff member. Most of your day is expense submission and your own claims.
role.account_officer: You're an Account Officer. Your queue runs through accounting verification.
role.account_supervisor: You're an Account Supervisor. You co-sign journal entries and own accounting supervision.
role.accounting_manager: You're an Accounting Manager. You authorise all accounting flow up to disbursement.
role.finance: You're on the Finance team. You sit between accounting and CFO.
role.cfo: You're the CFO. Above 200k THB disbursement routes through you.
role.ceo: You're the CEO. Every disbursement over 200k THB ends at your desk.
role.hr_manager: You manage HR. Tile-gate requests and people pages route through you.
role.admin: You have system admin. The matrix, audits, and policy lints are yours to tune.
